subject: Judge-mediated contradiction supersession (gated) in Zonoid memory core
description: Add automatic contradiction-detection that routes to the existing judge for supersession, gated behind ZONOID_CONTRADICTION_RESOLUTION (default OFF; bench daemon sets it ON). Three changes, reusing the existing consolidate->supersedeNote path (no routes/judge.js change). (A) lib/judge.js: add CONTRADICTION_BAND_LOW=0.80 const, contradictionResolutionEnabled() env gate, and findContradictionCandidates(newId,newVec,overlay,low,high) mirroring findSubsumedNotes but returning notes in the body-vec band [0.80, SUBSUMPTION_THRESHOLD) that are current+predating (NON-destructive). Export all. (B) routes/overlay.js: after the subsumption block in the POST /overlay/note handler, when contradictionResolutionEnabled(), seed for each candidate a 'contradicts' CANDIDATE context edge new->old via overlayStore.addEdge(..., 'context', 1-sim, {judged:false, origin:'contradiction-seed', relation:'contradicts', by:'subconscious'}) + markEagerJudge so the judge adjudicates. Best-effort try/catch; does NOT hide the new note, does NOT auto-retire. (C) skills/self-learn/references/edge-judge.md: add a criterion section for contradicts-candidate edges (origin contradiction-seed) — when the newer note states a CONFLICTING/UPDATED fact about the SAME subject that REPLACES the older, emit consolidate{keep:<newer>, supersede:[<older>]} (the existing consolidate handler retires the older, as-of reversible); if complementary/unrelated, prune the edge and keep both. Conservative; only applies to contradiction-seed edges so it stays gated. Verify: node --check all; unit-test findContradictionCandidates returns band-only, excludes >=0.92 and <0.80 and superseded and newer notes.
